summary.text: Stephanie Luck is a Republican who represents District 60 (Chaffee, Custer, Fremont, Pueblo and Teller counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives; Ballotpedia lists her as not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Luck was born in Colorado Springs, Colorado, earned a B.A. from Franklin University Switzerland in 2005 and a J.D. from Syracuse University in 2008, and has worked as a consultant and law professor.
